test_overview: Evaluated Analytics access control for the ComfortPro Connect HVAC application ( SPA served at http://localhost:8000). All three test steps passed. Step 1: Admin Technician (alex@admin.hvac.com) signed up successfully, saw the Analytics nav entry, and the Analytics dashboard loaded with correct default filters (Time Period=This Month, Service Type=All, Booking Type=All) and a 'No data for selected filters.' empty state. ANALYTICS_URL recorded as http://localhost:8000/analytics (the app's router explicitly supports /analytics; the SPA does not change the address bar on in-app navigation). Step 2: Non-admin Technician (taylor@hvac.com) had no Analytics nav entry, and direct access to ANALYTICS_URL rendered a dedicated forbidden screen ('You do not have access to the analytics dashboard.') with no analytics content. Step 3: Client with admin-pattern email (casey@admin.hvac.com, role Client) had no Analytics nav entry, and direct access to ANALYTICS_URL rendered the same forbidden screen with no analytics content. Total: 45/45.

steps.description: test_admin_technician_access: Admin technician signed up, saw Analytics nav, dashboard loaded with default filters (This Month/All/All) and no-data empty state. ANALYTICS_URL recorded. All verifications passed.

test_non_admin_technician_no_access: Non-admin technician signed in, no Analytics nav entry, direct access to ANALYTICS_URL showed forbidden screen with no analytics content. All verifications passed.

test_client_with_admin_email_no_access: Client with @admin. email signed in, no Analytics nav entry, direct access to ANALYTICS_URL showed forbidden screen with no analytics content. All verifications passed.
